bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new facility for YMCA of the North Camp Northern Lights.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; YMCA CAMP NORTHERN LIGHTS LODGE. +]

[+$3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the YMCA of the North to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a facility on the campus of the YMCA Camp Northern Lights in St. Louis County, to integrate more campers and families to build community in the northern woods. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new facility for YMCA of the North Camp Northern Lights.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; YMCA CAMP NORTHERN LIGHTS LODGE.

$3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the YMCA of the North to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a facility on the campus of the YMCA Camp Northern Lights in St. Louis County, to integrate more campers and families to build community in the northern woods. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: APPROPRIATION; YMCA CAMP NORTHERN LIGHTS LODGE.

This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
